description: This file contains validation functions for chat message feedback, including existence checks and consistency validation for creation and update operations within a chat application.

methods.name: validateMessageExists
methods.description: Checks if a chat message with the given ID exists; throws error if not found.

methods.name: validateFeedbackExists
methods.description: Checks if feedback with the given ID exists; throws error if not found.

methods.name: validateFeedbackForCreation
methods.description: Validates and prepares a feedback object for creation, ensuring message and chat IDs are consistent.

methods.name: validateFeedbackForUpdate
methods.description: Validates and updates a feedback object for modification, ensuring consistency with existing data.

search-terms: chat message and chatflow ID consistency
